{{Top|leg}}
A '''[[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-[[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] peace conference''' occurred sometime during the life of [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]], which Baobab attended. Though the goal of the conference was peace, it appeared that there was some major disagreement between the two [[Species/Legends|species]]. Baobab himself experienced some permanent hair loss from what might have been shouting between the two sides.
